evidence.name: Screen field: Place the close button left or right
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Place the close button left or right" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Place the close button left or right
sections.description: Puts the X on the start side (left in most languages, right in right-to-left ones) or the end side of the header; the sides flip automatically by language. Default to the start/top-left to match common mobile paywall convention. Move it to the end only when your hero layout needs that corner kept clear.
